description: This source file defines an actor 'DiagnosticsFileLog' responsible for logging diagnostic information into a JSONL file, managing rotation and cleanup of log files, and providing static methods for checking status and retrieving directories.

classes.name: DiagnosticsFileLog
classes.description: An actor managing diagnostic log entries, writing them into a JSONL file, and handling log file rotation and directory management.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if logging is enabled based on UserDefaults setting.

methods.name: logDirectoryURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the directory where logs are stored.

methods.name: logFileURL
methods.description: Returns the full URL of the current log file.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a diagnostic event with a category, event name, and optional fields.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all log files and backups from the log directory.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Handles writing a record to the log file, including directory creation and rotation.

methods.name: ensureDirectory
methods.description: Ensures that the log directory exists.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a record as a JSON line to the log file.

methods.name: rotateIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks the log file size and rotates the files if size exceeds the maximum.

methods.name: rotatedURL
methods.description: Generates a URL for a rotated log file based on an index.
